report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Stability of right knee joint
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There is mild subcortical cystic change and marrow edema in the patella most pronounced at the apex where there is overlying chondromalacia. There is mild osteophytosis in the patellofemoral joint compartment. Minimal osteophytosis is noted in the medial and lateral joint compartments. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
There is a small to moderate-sized joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. There is a small to moderate-sized Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Moderate to severe chondromalacia.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild chondromalacia.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Severe chondromalacia.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. 

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.


IMPRESSION:
1. Moderate to severe osteoarthritis.
2. No tear identified.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Contusión de la rodilla izquierda.
Hallazgos:
Lesión ósea medular de estirpe condroide a la región diafisaria distal del fémur de 12 x 3 mm en
sus ejes mayores, sin signos que sugieran agresividad regional. No hay otras alteraciones de
señal de la médula ósea.
Transformación quística parcial del LCA. LCP y ligamentos colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no impresiona
contactar de manera categórica la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales sin alteraciones. Úlcera condral focal de espesor
total de la región central de la tróclea femoral con mínimos cambios óseos secundarios.
Condropatía superficial rotuliana difusa.
Mínimo derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo, no complicado.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Aumento de
señal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Edema las partes blandas rodeando la banda iliotibial, en especial profunda y adyacente al cóndilo
femoral lateral.
Edema del tejido celular subcutáneo del aspecto anterior de la rodilla con fenómenos de fibrosis
en la región prepatelar.
Impresión:
Condropatía grado 4 focal de la región central de la tróclea femoral. Condropatía superficial de la
rótula.
Pequeño quiste poplíteo no complicado. Mínimo derrame articular.
Tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
Fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial.
Edema del tejido celular subcutáneo del aspecto anterior de la rodilla con fenómenos de fibrosis
en la región prepatelar.
Pequeña lesión de estirpe condroide medular diafisaria distal del fémur, sin signos de agresividad
regional.
Paciente: [NAME]

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kleine Zysten- und Ödembildung im dorsomedialen Tibiaplateau (Serie 4/ Image 23). Oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten in der Belastungszone femorotibial. Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Medial betonte osteophytäre Ausziehungen auch angrenzend an das mediale Plateau am ventralen Tuberculum mediale. Mukoide Degeneration des Innenmeniskushinterhorns. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten in der Belastungszone femorotibial. Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Osteophytäre Ausziehungen an der lateralen Femurcondyle. Ossifikationen/Ossikel entlang der Popliteussehne (Serie 6/ Image 22). Mukoide Degeneration des Außenmeniskushinterhorns. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Teils flächig fehlender Knorpelbesatz an der medialen und lateralen Patellafacette mit angrenzendem subchondralen Ödem und Geröllzysten (Serie 7/ Image 11). Vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt an der Trochlea mit subchondralem Knochenödem und Geröllzysten.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. Kleine Baker-Zyste.

Subhondralni koštani edem medijalnog dijela medijalnog epikondila femura i medijalnog platoa
tibije koji se uvlači i u rubne osteofite, izraženije medijalno. Denudacija zglobnih ploha femura i
tibije u medijalnoj faseti, sa reduciranom širinom intraartikularnog prostora, u sklopu
hondromalacije IV. stupnja - OA promjene.
Uzure tibijalne hrskavice u lateralnoj faseti, u sklopu hondromalacije III. stupnja - OA promjene.
Umjerena količina izljeva u FT zglobu i suprapatelarnoj burzi (tip I.) u kojoj se u kranijalnom dijelu
vide sinovijalne vegetacije - dif. dg. sinovitis.
Prednji i stražnji križni ligamenti prate se u kontinuitetu, prednji degenerativno izmijenjen.
Medijalni menisk povišenog intenziteta signala korpusa i stražnjeg roga s ekstruzijom za oko 5
mm, u sklopu degeneracije, uz radijalnu rupturu prednjeg roga.
Lateralni menisk blaže degeneriran, bez rupture.
Medijalni i lateralni kolateralni ligament urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu, lateralni
valovito konturiran.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa.
Patelarni ligament povišenog intenziteta signala pri tibijalnoj inserciji /artefakti pomicanja/.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Hondromalacijske promjene IV. stupnja patelarne hrskavice uz rubne osteofite - OA promjene.
Manji edem Hoffine masti i prepatelarnog masnog tkiva.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Trastorno interno de la rodilla.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral presenta aumento de señal central de su cuerno posterior que no impresiona contactar
con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Rotura compleja del cuerpo, cuerno posterior y parte de la raíz meniscal posterior del menisco medial con
segmento parcialmente desplazado receso menisco tibial y edema las partes blandas adyacentes.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total periféricas del cóndilo femoral medial con cambios óseos
secundarios. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial del resto del compartimento femorotibial medial.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial lateral sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial del aspecto periférico de la vertiente lateral de la tróclea femoral.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total con cambios óseos secundarios de distribución difusa de la rótula.
Aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
Leve derrame articular con discreta sinovitis. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de
límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con segmento parcialmente desplazado receso menisco tibial y edema
las partes blandas adyacentes.
Condropatía lesiones focales grado 3 y 4 periféricas del cóndilo femoral medial. Condropatía con lesiones
grado 2 del resto del compartimento femorotibial medial.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 3 de la tróclea femoral. Condropatía con lesiones grado 4 de la rótula.
Signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular.

In the medial compartment, there is complex tear (main radial component) at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the medial gutter. There is diffuse high grade and low grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. 
  
 The lateral compartment, there is complex tear with buckethandle tear at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is focal high grade chondrosis at the the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.5* 1.9 cm). There is subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is focal grade  chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the medial patellar facet (about 1.3* 1 cm). The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Minimal amount of right knee effusion is present.The surrounding musculature is normal.  Mild medial tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema and osteophytes.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the lateral patellar facet and high-grade partial-thickness fissuring at the median ridge. No focal full-thickness defect.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild to moderate degenerative distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis without superimposed tear.
Patella tendon: Severe patellar tendinosis with superimposed high-grade interstitial tearing of the mid anterior fibers spanning the length of the tendon craniocaudally. No full-thickness component or fiber retraction. Associated prepatellar subcutaneous soft tissue edema.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Diffuse extensor mechanism tendinopathy involving the patellar greater than quadriceps tendon with superimposed partial-thickness interstitial tearing of the patellar tendon. Findings may be related to overuse however given patient clinical history gout should also be considered, although no superimposed osseous erosive change is identified.
2.	Mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

МР находка: Наличие на ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална форма, структура и сигнален интензитет. Малки остеофитни наслоявания по кондилите и епикондилите на тибията и фемура. Визуализира се дефект в хрущяла покриващ медиалния кондил на бедрената кост на протежение 7мм. Няма данни за други дефекти в ставния хрущял на тибията и фемура. Латерализирана патела-Wiberg III. Единични хиперинтенсни зони в ретропателарния хрущял- хондропатия grade I. Налице са хоризонтална и коса лезии в заден рог на медиален мениск не достигащи ставната повръност-grade II a-c. Дегенеративни промени по заден рог на латерален мениск. Кръстни връзки – запазена цялост. Колатерални лигаменти със запазена цялост. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Многокамеран неруптурирала Бекерова киста между медиалната и латералната глава на м.гастрокнемиус. Руптурирала Бекерова киста на нивото на медиалната глава на м.гастрокнемиус. Заключение: МР данни за лезия на заден рог на медиален мениск- grade II a-c.  Фемурална и ретропателарна хондропатия. Патела Wiberg III. Бекерови кисти. Малък ставен излив.
